title: pvCGNSSeriesReader
body:
## pvCGNSSeriesReader

Reads CFD General Notation System files (.cgns, ADF or HDF5 based) into a multiblock dataset organized by base and zone: each zone becomes a structured or unstructured grid and, with LoadPatches, its boundary-condition patches are added beside the volume mesh. Field arrays come from FlowSolution_t nodes as point, cell or face data, and several files in FileNames form a time series. Choose it for general CGNS solver output; use pvIOSSReader for CGNS files that the IOSS library supports, and pvCONVERGECFDCGNSReader for CONVERGE CGNS post files with parcels.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- In the VTK reader every point, cell and face array starts disabled, so an unconfigured node usually has geometry but no fields; name the arrays in CellArrayStatus or PointArrayStatus.
- Only the first base is read by default; list further bases in Bases.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this reader, so inspect the output blocks, arrays and time steps on your own files before relying on it.

Native constructor: `CGNSSeriesReader`. Identity: `sources/CGNSSeriesReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Bases` | Names of the CGNS bases (CGNSBase_t nodes, the top-level groups that hold zones) to read; each selected base becomes one block of the output. Listing names is exclusive: ParaView switches every other available name off, so include all you need; an empty list reads none. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `CacheConnectivity` | When true, the element connectivity of unstructured zones is read once and reused from memory at later time steps instead of being re-read at every step. It shortens transient reads on a fixed mesh at the cost of memory and does not change the values read. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `CacheMesh` | When true, zone point coordinates are read once, stored per base and zone, and reused at later time steps instead of being re-read. It saves read time for transient results on a static mesh at the cost of memory. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `CellArrayStatus` | Names of cell-centred FlowSolution_t fields (CellCenter location) to load as cell data on the zone blocks. Used when DataLocation is "Cell Data"; face-centred fields are chosen in FaceArrayStatus instead. Listing names is exclusive: ParaView switches every other available name off, so include all you need; an empty list reads none. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `CreateEachSolutionAsBlock` | Debug option: when true, every FlowSolution_t node of a zone is output as its own child block under that zone, instead of the solution for the current time step being attached to the zone mesh. VTK warns that the output may not be correct, so it is meant for inspecting file structure, not for analysis. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `DataLocation` | Specifies whether to read cell or face information from the mesh. Face-based reading is only available if the element connectivity is defined with NGON_n element type. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Cell Data","Face Data"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Cell Data"` |
| `DoublePrecisionMesh` | When true, mesh coordinates are stored as 64-bit doubles; false stores 32-bit floats and halves coordinate memory. When the file's precision differs from the requested one, the coordinates are converted while reading, which costs time. Field arrays are not affected. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `FaceArrayStatus` | Names of face-centred FlowSolution_t fields (FaceCenter location) to load. Used only when DataLocation is "Face Data", which builds the mesh from faces and requires NGON_n element connectivity. Listing names is exclusive: ParaView switches every other available name off, so include all you need; an empty list reads none. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `Families` | Names of CGNS families (Family_t nodes, such as a family grouping wall patches or a fluid region) whose zones and boundary patches are read. Zones or patches tagged with a family that is not selected are skipped; zones without a family are always read. Listing names is exclusive: ParaView switches every other available name off, so include all you need; an empty list reads none. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `FileNames` | The list of files to be read by the reader. If more than 1 file is specified, the reader will switch to file series mode in which it will pretend that it can support time and provide 1 file per time step. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"items":{"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"minItems":1,"type":"array"}` | `required` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `IgnoreFlowSolutionPointers` | When checked, the reader will simply ignore **FlowSolutionPointers** in the CGNS file since they are either incomplete or invalid. To locate unsteady solution, the **UseUnsteadyPattern** option should then be activated. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `IgnoreReaderTime` | When reading a file-series, if each file in the series does not provide correct time information, the reader will not be able to animate through the file series correctly. Check this to ignore the time information provided by each file. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `LoadMesh` | Toggle whether zone mesh must be read for selected bases/families. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `LoadPatches` | Toggle whether boundary condition patches must be read for selected bases/families. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `PointArrayStatus` | Names of vertex-located FlowSolution_t fields (Vertex location) to load as point data on the zone blocks. Listing names is exclusive: ParaView switches every other available name off, so include all you need; an empty list reads none. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `UnsteadySolutionStartTimestep` | Index assigned to the first time step when UseUnsteadyPattern matches FlowSolution_t nodes by the time-step index at the end of their names. Only used when UseUnsteadyPattern is true; the value must be 0 or more. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `Use3DVector` | When true, vector fields of a 2-D solution (physical dimension 2) get a third component so they behave as 3-D vectors in filters such as glyphs or stream tracing; false keeps the solution's physical dimension (two components). It has no effect on 3-D cases. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `UseUnsteadyPattern` | When true, the reader finds the FlowSolution_t node for each time step by name pattern (nodes whose names end in the time-step index) instead of relying on FlowSolutionPointers. Use it, usually together with IgnoreFlowSolutionPointers, for unsteady files whose pointers are missing or invalid; UnsteadySolutionStartTimestep sets the first index. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvCGNSSeriesReader",
  "options": {
    "FileNames": [
      "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
    ]
  }
}
```
